title: The Five States of Matter
notes:
The Five States of Matter

  • 1. Solid: Definite shape & volume. Strong intermolecular attraction, low kinetic energy.
  • 2. Liquid: Indefinite shape, definite volume. Higher kinetic energy than solids.
  • 3. Gas: Indefinite shape & volume. Negligible attraction, perpetual motion.
  • 4. Plasma: Fourth state. Formed at high temperatures (~10,000°C) with free ionized electrons.
  • 5. Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC): Fifth state. Boson gas cooled near absolute zero, forming a single 'super atom'.
summary: Overview of Solid, Liquid, Gas, Plasma, and Bose-Einstein Condensate.
